notes: LANGFLOW_AUTO_LOGIN=False requires authentication instead of exposing a superuser session. The initial administrator is admin with a generated password; LANGFLOW_NEW_USER_IS_ACTIVE=False prevents newly registered users from becoming active without approval.
Only Langflow publishes a loopback port. PostgreSQL is private, with a dedicated database and user, and LANGFLOW_CONFIG_DIR persists logs, file storage and configuration in a separate named volume.

The upstream v1.12.5 example uses PostgreSQL 16-trixie to stabilize its Debian base. This new recipe pins the verified PostgreSQL 16.15-alpine patch as requested; do not switch an existing database volume between libc families without checking collation compatibility.
The latest verified Langflow release is pinned rather than older versions affected by CVE-2025-3248. The 2g application floor is provisional until both-OS live memory checks.
Exact release tags were verified for linux/amd64. Tested lists remain empty until live verification on Ubuntu 24.04 and 26.04.
